enGuide: Di-Sword quiz, statement 1 of 5 (the first statement is worded the same in every set): 「剣が見えた」 ("I saw a sword"). A wrong answer ends the game, and the game shows one of three statement sets, so read the wording first. Answers by set: set Z (the Steam chart; later statements はっきりと剣が見えた / なんとなく剣に見えただけ) = YES; set Y (はっきりと剣が見えた / ここから動けるなら取りに行ける) = YES; set X (剣っぽいものは見えた / 幻覚としては見えた) = NO. Set X is printed by gameline.jp (Set B); set Y by fllayg (PSP port), the Trivial Achievements wiki (Xbox 360 era), the Gorilla wiki chapter-6 page (no platform stated) and a PSP play log; set Z only by Set A, the Steam chart. This step follows set Z, the Steam-specific chart; which set the Steam build actually shows is unconfirmed.
